The setting (h=100, triple-indexed banks, wire counts W_b, W_c) is not given.

Labels, terminal labels, stage transitions, the decreasing central 3->4 edges losing h, L=Ich, Wm-2N+2L and L/N=100/539, 101/539 are all stated, and the telescoping count follows 1061-1071. But the pairing |S∩T|-1 is attributed to both label fields (the binary one uses the dot product, 867-868), m=h^3 is never defined, and the gate-label table and edge-by-edge residual table (975-1043) that establish comparability are only cited, not reconstructed.

Projections P_U at gates and sinks, -P_{U_a} at X_a sources, rank(P_V-P_U)=dim V-dim U, the 2P_{U_a} rank-one exception, s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b with deficit N-2L_b, and the endpoint difference I_m on every role all match 1156-1171. The frames Phi_M and the resulting shear H<-H+D appear in S2.2.2-S2.2.4.

Kernel per orthonormal residual vector, s_c=W_c m-2N+2L_c<W_c m and C^{⊗m} on every role are stated, but the phase frame C_U=H^{⊗m}diag(i^{q_U})H^{⊗m} is never defined. The derivation gives the orthonormal-basis fact and the Z-correction on the 27 coordinates, but omits the core step at 1232-1257 (weight additivity mod 4 for orthogonal vectors, q_V-q_U as a sum over the basis, and the conversion of i^{eps[v.x]} into aI+bX_v).

Has L<N/2 with the exact ratios, s_b<W_b m, s_c<W_c m, deficits above 20*2^-50, log m<20 and the exponential inequality giving s/W<m^tau with tau=sigma=1-2^-50, following 1331-1344. The relative deficits eta_b, eta_c are neither defined nor given their exact values.
Only invoked by name ('by the controlled shifts lemma', stream-ops and controlled-shifts in relies-on); no step states the O(V) digit operations, row splitting, or the controlled-shift condition.

Factorization A=E_1 Pi E_2 by topmost-row/rightmost-entry pivoting, O(V) lower triangular transforms, and the one-interchange realisation D_j<-D_j+H_i, swap, D_j<-H_i-D_j all match 1375-1446, giving exactly a interchanges.

Row split into W role streams, Phi_{A_e} by recursive matrix shears, Phi_{I_m} on every role, merge, three-shear swap, s calls of volume V/W, F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1), the geometric sum, and the depth-first fixed-tape schedule all follow the proof.
High digits as a row field R=q^{2rho}>=W^k, padding to a multiple of W^k, base-m pieces with sum O(Ve^tau), padding binary ranges to [q^e], and unequal widths by one bit move; all as in 1649-1762.

Edge frame change as product of C_{v_j}^{eps_j}, conjugation by P_M to slot coordinates, (C^{-1})^{⊗f}=(-i)^f Z C Z, exactly s_c children on f=e/m axes, fixed number of row additions, and H_0^{⊗D}=b^D S_D C^{⊗D} S_D match 1835-1931.

Eight packed additions with the parity cycles, output (u+c(1-2(u mod 2)),w), packed cyclic shift, guard interval 10<=g<=2^{K-1}-11, delta_bad, repair by extraction and radix sort, final two-bit XOR and the cost all match the proof.

Node overhead O(V((eK)^tau+1)), rows sent to roles with child volume V/W, F(e)<=(s/W)F(e/m)+O((eK)^tau+1) with leaves F(e)=O(e), the internal/leaf sums and the base-m piece sum are present. The step converting the overhead to O(e^lambda) via K<=e^{c/beta} and tau(1+c/beta)<lambda (2413-2415) is skipped, and the row field from the first q_0 chunks is only alluded to.

errors.says: For triple indicator vectors <t_S,t_T>=|S∩T|-1, so neighbouring triple lines are orthogonal in the label field of either construction (also S1.3 method: 'whose pairings |S∩T|-1 make neighbouring triples orthogonal').
errors.paper: The pairing |S∩T|-1 holds only for the bit labels, F=Q^h with form x^T(I-J/9)y; the complex network uses F=F_2^h with the ordinary dot product (t_T.t_T=1), where neighbours (even intersection) are orthogonal for a different reason.

chain: The tree reaches the main bound by the paper's route: scalar exchange network, frames, nested labels, rank equal to dimension change, s<Wm, the matrix-shear recurrence giving O(Ve^tau), then the complex analogue for butterfly layers, transforms, resampling, chirp, CRT and exact recovery, then the cost table. It thins in the fixed setting (h=100, N, m=h^3 and W are never defined), in the complex phase interface (the weight-mod-4 argument that turns a residual basis into kernels aI+bX_v is missing), and in the guard-width depth recurrence; the label residual table is cited rather than reconstructed.

steps.note: The exchange (X_a,Y_a)->(-Y_a,X_a) with every auxiliary wire restored is reconstructed with its schedule, but h=100, the banks indexed by triples, N=binom(h,3)^3 and m=h^3 never appear, so N and m are used undefined later. Being conservative, this counts as mentioned.
Common frame per gate commutes with the pointwise gate, giving D_out S D_in^{-1}, so each edge is only a change of frame.
Nondegenerate subspaces of F^{⊗3} of dimension m, comparable labels on every edge, and only the central 3->4 edges decreasing, each by h; m=h^3 is not spelled out.
rank(P_V-P_U)=dim V-dim U, with the N source edges (2P_{U_a}) as rank-one exceptions.
Sum of |Δdim| = Wm-2N+2L with L=Ich, and s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b.
L/N=100/539 and 101/539 below 1/2, so the deficit N-2L_b>0 and s<Wm.
M_sink(rho(w))-M_source(w)=I_m on every role, so the network applies H<-H+D on every row including scratch rows.
A=E_1 Pi E_2, exactly a interchanges plus O(V), so a node makes s recursive calls.
Children of volume V/W, F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1), s/W<m^tau with tau=1-2^-50 from eta>20*2^-50 and log m<20, giving F_k=O(e^tau).

central.summary: The plan reconstructs the central chain from frames through labels, rank equal to dimension change, the budget, L/N<1/2, the endpoint identity, edges as recursive calls and the recurrence giving tau=1-2^-50. Only the starting setting is thin: the network's exchange and restoration are derived, but h=100, the triple indexing, N and m are never stated.
